notes.title: Doodler 1.5.0 Brings new animations and graphics options
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25303731/bcedde69bd7a5362977d3b74333871a0956f53ae.gif[/img]

Hello Everyone!

I am happy to announce the Doodler 1.5.0 Update. This update is focused on polishing and improving performance. 

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Our little doodle character now has varied animations for each theme
[*]Controllers will now have dynamic sensititvity for easier menu navigation
[/list]

[h1]Performance Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]The V Sync and AA settings can now be individually set
[*]Added ability to disable map particles (dust \ light rays)
[*]Removed old unclear quality levels
[*]Option for FullScreen will now work more consistently 
[/list]

Enjoy
- SolarByte
:boi::doodler::exhausted::okay::mrsunshine:

notes.title: Doodler 1.4.0 Adds ability to remap inputs
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25303731/617951bfb1c9c3139bf6e9deaf76666c39c846e7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Why?[/h1]
The default configurations will work for qwerty keyboard and Xbox controllers.
If you use a different keyboard layout or wish to use a non-Xbox controller this menu will allow you to remap controls for Doodler.

[h1]Open Configuration Window[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Hold the "Alt" key
[*] Click the "Play" button from the steam library
[*] Let go of the "Alt" key 
[*] Click on the "Input" tab
[*] From the "Input" tab you can double-click any control and remap it. 
[/olist]


[H1]Control Breakdown[/h1]
[list]
[*] Move Keyboard (+) ~ Move Right
[*] Move Keyboard (-) ~ Move Left
[*] Move Controller ~ Used for joystick control of movement
[*] Jump ~ Jump
[*] Use/Grab ~ Activate levers and grab boxes
[*] Start ~ Open pause menu, Close various menus
[*] Move Camera X Keyboard (+) ~ Move camera right
[*] Move Camera X Keyboard (-) ~ Move camera left
[*] Move Camera X Controller ~ Used for joystick control of camera
[*] Move Camera Y Keyboard (+) ~ Move camera up
[*] Move Camera Y Keyboard (-) ~ Move camera down
[*] Move Camera Y Controller ~ Used for joystick control of camera
[/list]

[H1]Controller Mouse Mode[/h1]
In order to provide compatibility to play with a controller Doodler attempts to emulate a mouse with a controller. If you launch the game with a controller plugged in you will see the following popup.

"Move Camera X Controller" and "Move Camera Y Controller" will be used to move the mouse.
"Jump" will "Left Click"
"Use/Grab" will "Right Click"

Note: The mouse will continue to function at all times.

There is a known issue with certain configurations that causes this system to lock the cursor to a corner of the screen. If this happens simply hit the Esc key and Controller Mouse Control will be disabled for the remainder of the play session.

notes.title: Doodler is now Free!
notes.content:
[h1]That's right Doodler is now 100% free.[/h1]

No need to worry, no loot boxes or microtransactions, just a free game. We hope that this change will vitalize the community and bring even more value to the workshop. Have fun and enjoy and don't forget to upload your creations for the rest of the community to play!

[h1]Previously owned the game? [/h1]
Don't worry we have a special DLC in the works.
This DLC is an exclusive free gift for the original supporters.
Expect this DLC to appear in your accounts in the next few days.

Enjoy
- SolarByte
ːboiːːdoodlerːːexhaustedːːmrsunshineːːokayː

notes.title: Doodler 1.2.0 Brings Major Updates and Fixes
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We are happy to announce the Doodler 1.2.0 Update. This update will contain several new Features and Bug fixes.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added sun rays in Child and Adult levels
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25303731/342f31abd641e04c6f6330041f782186e9bc0cb0.gif[/img]
[*]Added dust in Teen and Elder levels
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25303731/12523394dd0136e458f717b854573f7b9cabd7b3.gif[/img]
[*]Added Win animation.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25303731/7f93600519c3dc8d78e143eee3e0fe7f39b6322f.gif[/img]
[*]Added 3D sound to reduce noise pollution
[*]Bounce Block will no longer play multiple sounds when player dies on it
[*]Added Eraser turn SFX
[*]Added shrink effect when erasers turn around
[*]Erasers will now look the direction they are moving (left\right)
[*]Added SFX to eraser launcher when shooting
[*]Added SFX to eraser heads from launcher on impact
[*]Added grow effect when eraser launcher shoot
[*]Added delay to eraser launcher if the erase head hits within 0.5 seconds (reduce noise and awkward animation)  
[*]Normalized volume of all lose and win SFX
[*]Added Click SFX to most buttons
[*]Added grow effect to buttons in editor
[*]Changed the fullscreen button's hitbox to be the checkbox instead of the text
[*]Physics Boxes now have voices
[*]Physics Boxes will now look at you when in range
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the following to not work when steam was offline
[list]
[*]Jumping
[*]Death
[*]Launching the game on a certain day
[*]loading levels 2-1, 3-1, 4-1, 4-27
[*]Uploading a level to the steam workshop
[*]Running the game for longer than 1 hour
[/list]
[*]Fixed Teen box appearing as Adult box
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25303731/449c6766bb0425a149bd24dbb51218da433ae3b5.png[/img]
[/list]

Enjoy
- SolarByte
